name: Glass API call
oneLiner: an API client on glass: Send is pressed, a lit packet runs up the wire to a server tile whose lights blink, a green packet runs back, 200 OK stamps and the JSON response unfolds key by key
say: when the speaker says one call does the work ('it is one API call', 'you send the request and it comes back with everything'): the packet leaves on 'send', 200 OK lands on 'comes back', the keys light as the speaker lists what is inside
